Calculate RF-EMF Dose from online gaming (console)

gaming_dose.Rd

Calculates the tissue-specific RF-EMF dose from online gaming

Usage

gaming_dose(tissue, duration_gaming, params = load_params())

Arguments

tissue

Tissue for which to calculate dose (default: "brain" or "body")

duration_gaming

duration of gaming with portable console in s/day

params

Parameter list (optional). If not specified, calculations use default parameters.

Value

Tissue-specific RF-EMF dose from gaming in mJ/kg/day

Details

The RF-EMF dose from online gaming is calculated as:

$$Dose_{gaming} = mSAR_{gaming} \times duration_{gaming}$$ $$mSAR_{gaming} = f_{online} \times \sum_{b} s_{b} \times nSAR_{b} \times DC_{b} \times P_{b}$$

Where:

  • \(mSAR_{gaming}\) is the mSAR of gaming in mW/kg

  • \(f_{online}\) is the share of the gaming time online (parameter gaming_online_prop)

  • \(s_{b}\) is the share of the WiFi frequency band \(b\) (2.4 and 5 GHz)

  • \(nSAR_{b}\) is the normalized SAR in W/kg/W

  • \(P_{b}\) and \(DC_{b}\) are the output power in mW and the duty cycle of the console

  • \(duration_{gaming}\) is the duration of gaming with portable console in s/day

Examples

gaming_dose(
  tissue          = "body",
  duration_gaming = 600)
#> [1] 1.865883
